purpose: Determine whether the full-accuracy reference column has a mass-conserving one-step root that crosses top-cell h=0 under imposed top flux at or below KSAT, before attempting another candidate saturation-transition qualification fixture.
selection_rule: A shared feasible tuple must have accepted full-accuracy reference roots for all four materials, top-cell h crossing from -0.2 cm to >=0 in all four, mass residual <=1e-9 cm, finite heads, and max head <0.8 cm. Prefer lowest q fraction, then smallest dt.
efficiency_constraints: Stop no earlier than full frozen grid evaluation; selection is deterministic after evaluation.
hard_nonclaims: No forcing tuple may be promoted directly to qualification without a new frozen precommit.
